goal.text: Stay safe when it shakes outside.

intro.text: It is recess. You are outside when the ground shakes!

hint.text: Where is there nothing that can fall on you?

lesson.text: Outside? Move to an open area, away from trees, posts and buildings.

choices.label: Hide under the big tree
choices.feedback: Stay away from trees when the ground shakes.

choices.label: Go to the open field
choices.feedback: Move to an open area. Stay away from trees, posts and buildings.

choices.label: Run back into the building
choices.heading: Not safe yet
choices.feedback: Stay away from buildings while it shakes. Go to an open area.

choices.label: Stand by the electric post
choices.feedback: Stay away from posts and power lines.
